title: find_immutable_patch_key allocates format string per (key, field) pair in inner loop
description: email.rs:558 — key.starts_with(&format!("{field}/")) allocates a new String for every combination of patch key and immutable field (up to 26*N allocations per update call). Fix: key == field || (key.starts_with(field) && key.as_bytes().get(field.len()) == Some(&b'/'))
